stock.description: Cheuk Nang (Holdings) Limited operates as an investment holding enterprise, primarily engaged in the acquisition, development, oversight, and sale of real estate assets. Its geographic footprint covers mainland China, Hong Kong, and Malaysia. The company's business activities are structured into distinct divisions, including property sales, rental services, estate management, and other ancillary operations. It undertakes the construction and development of residential, commercial, and retail properties. Furthermore, the firm extends into offering administrative and secretarial services, participating in securities markets, and providing mortgage financing. Incorporated in 1963, the company was formerly named Far East Wool & Fibre Mill, Limited, adopting its current identity, Cheuk Nang (Holdings) Limited, in 1988. Its corporate base is situated in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, and it functions as a subsidiary of Yan Yin Company Limited.
